ios.desc:
Expand Your Vocabulary with Lexicon – The Ultimate Flashcards App

Unlock the power of words with Lexicon, your personalized vocabulary flashcards app designed to help you learn and master any language efficiently. Whether you’re enhancing your native language skills or diving into a new language, Lexicon uses cutting-edge AI technology to make learning seamless and effective.

Key Features
	•	Automatic Flashcard Creation
	•	Simply add any word, and Lexicon instantly generates a flashcard with a precise definition powered by GPT’s advanced language model.
	•	Multi-Language Support
	•	Learn and translate words in 30+ languages, including popular options like Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, and many more. Whether it’s European, Asian, African, or even constructed languages like Klingon and Esperanto, Lexicon has you covered.
	•	Seamless Language Learning
	•	Automatically translate words into your chosen language to build your vocabulary effortlessly. Perfect for language learners at any level.
	•	Spaced Repetition System (SRS)
	•	Enhance retention and recall with our scientifically-backed spaced repetition algorithm, ensuring you remember words exactly when you need them.
	•	AI-Powered Definitions and Translations
	•	Unlike traditional apps with limited databases, Lexicon leverages GPT to provide accurate, context-aware definitions and translations for any word you enter.
	•	Customizable Learning Experience
	•	Tailor your study sessions to fit your personal learning style and pace. Track your progress and stay motivated with detailed statistics.
	•	User-Friendly Interface
	•	Enjoy a clean, intuitive design that makes adding, reviewing, and managing your flashcards a breeze.

Why Choose Lexicon?
	•	Comprehensive Language Support: From widely spoken languages to niche and constructed ones, Lexicon supports a diverse range to cater to all learners.
	•	AI-Enhanced Learning: Benefit from the latest advancements in language processing with GPT-powered content generation.
	•	Efficient Learning Methodology: Our spaced repetition system maximizes your learning efficiency, helping you build a robust vocabulary faster.
	•	Constant Updates: We continuously expand our language offerings and enhance features based on user feedback to provide the best learning tool possible.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Vocabulary flashcards that use LLMs for definitions and translations

quotes.text:
SwiftUI. Cloud Firestore. GPT-4o-mini.
Add a word or phrase and get a definition or translation in any language. (Including Klingon). If you add a word like "fork (cutlery)" it will return that definition, and not e.g. a fork in the road, because the LLM understands your original intention. Supports offline review for the cards.
The design is based off of the Journals app in iOS. Suggestions and criticism welcome.
